name: Corporate Action Status Reason
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for a status of a corporate action.

CorporateActionCancellationReason.name: Corporate Action Cancellation Reason
CorporateActionCancellationReason.definition: Specifies reasons for cancellation of a corporate action event.

AcceptedReason.name: Accepted Reason
AcceptedReason.definition: Specifies additional information about the processed instruction.

MovementRejectionReason.name: Movement Rejection Reason
MovementRejectionReason.definition: Provides information about the rejection status.

Forwarded.name: Forwarded
Forwarded.definition: Instruction has been accepted and forwarded to the next intermediary in the chain.

ReceivedByIssuerOrOfferor.name: Received By Issuer Or Offeror
ReceivedByIssuerOrOfferor.definition: Instruction has been received and accepted by the issuer or offeror.

Returned.name: Returned
Returned.definition: Instructed units are returned or partially returned to the instructing party.

CorporateActionStatus.name: Corporate Action Status
CorporateActionStatus.definition: Corporate actions status for which a reason is provided.
